name: BELL
notes: Bell is observable only during full-screen input errors or field completion.

name: CARRY
notes: Carries record values during interactive APPEND/INSERT/EDIT entry.

name: CATALOG
notes: ON records used/created files in the CAT database; OFF does not; the batch LIST exposes the different contents.

name: CONFIRM
notes: Controls full-screen GET field advance behavior.

name: DEBUG
notes: Redirects batch ECHO trace to the printer, capturable as raw LPT bytes; omission scope decision pending operator.

name: DEFAULT
notes: Changes default drive/path and can be observed by subsequent file/database commands.

name: DELIMITERS
notes: Delimiters decorate full-screen GET fields.

name: DOHISTORY
notes: Default OFF omits nested program commands; ON records them for LIST HISTORY.

name: ECHO
notes: Echoes batch commands into the captured output stream; omission scope decision pending operator.

name: FIELDS
notes: SET FIELDS changes LIST/DISPLAY field output.

name: FIXED
notes: Changes numeric formatting visible through ? and LIST.

name: FORMAT
notes: Selects a screen format for interactive editing.

name: FUNCTION
notes: Rebinds function keys used by interactive command entry.

name: HEADINGS
notes: Real III+ HEADING, HEADINGS and four-letter HEAD accept ON/OFF with identical effects; shipped HEADING already names this setting.

name: HELP
notes: Controls interactive help prompts after syntax errors.

name: HISTORY
notes: LIST HISTORY exposes default capacity 20, changed capacities 3/12 and recording ON/OFF.

name: INTENSITY
notes: Changes screen attributes for GET fields.

name: MARGIN
notes: Raw ? printer output has zero/five/zero leading columns; PCOL itself excludes the margin. PRINTER.OUT pins the difference.

name: MEMOWIDTH
notes: A real M-field/DBT fixture wraps into different LIST lines at default 50 and changed 20 columns.

name: MENUS
notes: Controls full-screen edit-mode key menus.

name: MESSAGE
notes: Displays only on the status line.

name: PATH
notes: Changes file search used by subsequent batch file/database access.

name: PRINT
notes: OFF leaves PCOL unchanged; ON advances it. PRINTER.OUT also pins the actual raw LPT bytes.

name: PROCEDURE
notes: Loads procedures that can be called in a batch program and emit output.

name: SCOREBOARD
notes: Controls status/scoreboard screen indicators.

name: STEP
notes: Single-step debugger pauses for user input between program statements.

name: TITLE
notes: Controls interactive catalog title prompts.

name: TYPEAHEAD
notes: Changes keyboard input buffering.

name: UNIQUE
notes: Changes index construction; the resulting database/index listings are observable.

name: VIEW
notes: An original III+ VUE restores two work areas, indexes and relations; DBF()/LIST show different data without entering an editor.

name: AVERAGE
notes: Computes numeric means and writes TALK results or TO variables visible via ?.

name: COUNT
notes: Counts records and writes TALK results or TO variables visible via ?.

name: SUM
notes: Computes numeric totals and writes TALK results or TO variables visible via ?.

name: JOIN
notes: Combines matching records into output database rows that LIST can display.

name: UPDATE
notes: Updates records from a second database; changed values are visible through LIST.

name: INSERT
notes: INSERT BLANK adds after the current record; INSERT BEFORE BLANK adds before it; LIST shows physical renumbering.

name: EJECT
notes: EJECT resets PCOL from 3 to 0 and emits form-feed in PRINTER.OUT; trailing tokens raise no III+ error.

name: TEXT/ENDTEXT
notes: Emits literal text lines that can be captured from a batch program.

name: DIR
notes: Default DBF directory differs from skeleton/subdirectory output. Invalid drive/path probes print None without ON ERROR.

name: SUSPEND
notes: Suspends execution and waits for interactive user input.

name: CALL
notes: Loads/calls external binary modules, outside the batch xBase output oracle.

name: LOAD
notes: Loads external binary modules, outside the batch xBase output oracle.

name: IMPORT
notes: Transfers external PFS-format files; classify as a file-format/compatibility omission.

name: EXPORT
notes: Transfers external PFS-format files; classify as a file-format/compatibility omission.
